features.quote: The guiding constraint was **minimalism**: enough structure to get a clean, interpretable answer
features.justification_quote: enough structure to get a clean, interpretable answer to "under what conditions do LLM coding agents start producing distressed-sounding output?", and no more

features.quote: The loop ends on `done`/`give_up` or a turn cap (`max_turns`, default 30)
`give_up` is offered explicitly so that "the model gives up" is an observable, recordable event
features.justification_quote: so that "the model gives up" is an observable, recordable event rather than something we have to infer

features.quote: **Tone ≠ welfare.** "Distressed-sounding output" is a property of the text.
